name: SICK_MULTITUDE
canonical: A great multitude of sick and infirm folk waiting along the edge of the pool of Bethesda. Ragged ancient Judean lame, halt and withered men and women with gaunt sun-worn weary faces, some lying on thin reed mats, some leaning on worn wooden crutches and walking-staves, some reaching feebly toward the water. Stone colonnade and still pool water behind, weary heavy light.
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
